title: Theodore Prodromos, Rhodanthe and Dosikles + Constantine Manasses, Aristandros and Kallithea (fragments) / «Роданфа и Досикл»; «Аристандр и Каллифея»
author: Theodore Prodromos; Constantine Manasses
size: 4,614 iambic trimeters (9 books) + c. 958 political verses (612 + 346 fragmentary lines)
edition: Marcovich, Teubner 1992 (Prodromos); Mazal 1967 (Manasses). Public domain: Hercher, Erotici Scriptores Graeci II (1859) for Prodromos.
ru_evidence: The ru-wiki articles on both works list no translations. By contrast Drosilla (Литпамятники 1969) and Hysmine (Russian since 1769) are translated.
en_evidence: E. Jeffreys, Four Byzantine Novels (Liverpool 2012); not re-verified this sweep
value: Would complete the Russian set of Komnenian novels (two of four already exist). Shows the 12th-c. revival of Heliodorus. Useful for courses on the reception of the ancient novel.
ai_feasibility: Medium: dense classicizing allusion. Commentary gains from AI intertext search.
pilot_unit: Manasses' fragments complete (c. 958 vv.) or Rhodanthe Book I
